issue.title: Angular CLI 9.0.1 - Universal build is not generating server.js
issue.body:
# 🐞 Bug report ### Command (mark with an `x`) - [ ] new - [x] build - [ ] serve - [ ] test - [ ] e2e - [ ] generate - [ ] add - [ ] update - [ ] lint - [ ] xi18n - [ ] run - [ ] config - [ ] help - [ ] version - [ ] doc ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: < 9.0.0 ### Description A clear and concise description of the problem... Upon build:ssr - the server.js file is **not** created in the dist folder. The server and browser directories are built correctly though. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ng new TestSsrApp --routing --style=scss cd TestSsrApp ng add @nguniversal/express-engine npm run build:ssr Once this has completed the browser and server directories have been created however with no server.js. I've done this a few times now and always the same result. The app itself works locally when running commands such as npm run dev:ssr so it looks like just the server.js not being created is the issue. You can read more about issue submission guidelines here: https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#-submitting-an-issue --> ## 🔥 Exception or Error There are no errors shown ## 🌍 Your Environment

# 🐞 Bug report #### What modules are related to this issue? - [ ] aspnetcore-engine - [x] builders - [x] common - [x] express-engine - [ ] hapi-engine - [ ] module-map-ngfactory-loader ### Is this a regression? No ### Description Demo from https://angular.io/guide/universal not working ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction 1 ) Go to https://angular.io/guide/universal 2) Download https://angular.io/generated/zips/universal/universal.zip 3) Extract and get into the new extracted folder (named usually as **universal**) 4) Run `npm install && npm run build:ssr:dev && npm run serve:ssr` ## 🔥 Exception or Error I's doing nothing, but if I comment the following code: 

// Webpack will replace 'require' with '__webpack_require__'
// '__non_webpack_require__' is a proxy to Node 'require'
// The below code is to ensure that the server is run only when not requiring the bundle.
// declare const __non_webpack_require__: NodeRequire;
// const mainModule = __non_webpack_require__.main;
// if (mainModule && mainModule.filename === __filename) {
  run();
// }
in server.ts it works and a new error arise: **Error: Failed to lookup view "index" in views directory "/universal_demo/dist/express-engine-ivy/browser"** Change that path to be dist/browser result in a new error: **Error: Can't resolve all parameters for ApplicationModule: (?).** Also to fix that I've added the follwoing at the top of server.ts file: **import 'reflect-metadata';** Throws a new error that is related with a file not found (file from project) ``` errno: -2, code: 'ENOENT', syscall: 'open', path: 'my.component.html' } Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'my.component.html' Unhandled Promise rejection: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'my.component.html' ; Zone: ; Task: Promise.then ; Value: [Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'my.component.html ``` ## 🌍 Your Environment Linux Debian stretch Node 12.16.1 Angular: 9.0.6
